column2: tagline
Track Your Learning, Hands-Free.
We're using Rayneo glasses to help farmers farm more sustainably. Our app analyzes soil quality on-site, shows clear results, and lets farmers choose a crop to see how it would grow in that spot.
Lucid Weave is a living spatial manifestation of dreams where gestures sculpt music, melodies bloom into light, and the experience is worn
FurReact Ears are animatronic animal ears that move to reflect the user's emotions in real time utilizing Samsung Galaxy XR facial tracking
The Memory Tree is a physical-VR memorial where people leave shared memories of their loved ones who passed away. It helps with closure by creating a digital memorial that will last forever.
The app turns brainwave data and body movement into interactive sound and visuals. Using hand tracking, users create music with gestures, generating colors, particles, and forms in VR.
Kynd is an XR-AI project, designed to support people living with Alzheimer's and dementia by restoring what matters most in human connection: a sense of safety, familiarity, and presence.
Transform your surroundings into an infinite collaborative spatial interface! Go from 2D sketch to 3D reality using just your hands and voice - pure creative flow, no keyboard required.
dream.ee is a VR experience that learns what truly fulfills you by observing how you explore immersive worlds, then evolves future worlds to align with your authentic interests.
Designing and building a prototype game using the Meta mixed reality toolkit, for a fast paced experience, designed to be a prototype for future concepts
An XR learning system that lets students hold objects and see electric and magnetic fields update live in 3D, turning invisible physics into something you can touch and explore.
Attune transforms any space into a peaceful environment. Developed for Raven Resonance Glasses, it uses AR light-guided cues for accessible mental health support.
Smartglasses that remember and empower
A Biosensing Wearable and XR Experience for Translating Others' Emotions Through Haptic Feedback - We're turning "I hear you" into "I feel your heartbeat."
Gradient is an AR system that empowers all individuals to build any personalized tools through short conversation to generate adaptive tools directly on Raven Resonance's everyday-wear glasses.

column1: OurLife : A Second Brain for Those Who Need It Most
column2: Help people with memory loss live independently, with dignity, and stay connected to their loved ones.
A two player co-op XR game where human intention is filtered through an AI intermediary, revealing how trust, agency, and consequence shift when machines mediate our shared dreams.
Jazz Casters is an interactive music-driven spellcasting tower-defense game where players use hand gestures to compose music and combat the enemies in real time.
Survive an alien threat by using a mixed-reality control panel to scan rooms, open valves, and shut doors.
An Edge AI powered fitness coach that tracks your movement and corrects your form in real time through the Samsung Galaxy XR headset.

A communication tool that translates spoken language into visual and spatial cues, helping individuals with vision impairments better understand sound and making communication systems more accessible.

A playful XR dreaming machine for everyday dilemmas: draw a temptation in Android XR, Gemini Live brings it to life, and a robot becomes your angel/devil debate so you leave with a decision you trust.
We gave a fighting robot sensation with sensors and the ability to express/read emotion through conversational ai to run real world simulations for human users to practice de-escalation/ compassion
Factories expect perfect memory, focus, and pace. Keystone is an AR system that supports human judgment with real-time sensors, making invisible risks visible before mistakes become disasters.
Human dreams, AI reflections, Immersive encounters
Convince HAL to help you escape Jupiter before it explodes. This is an immersive VR narrative game based on the sequel of Stanley Kubrick's 2001: A Space Odyssey.

column1: Care Nest: AR Bottle Tracking for Sleep-Deprived Parents
column2: No more mental math, no more "is this still good?"—Care Nest uses AR to track bottle safety, so you can focus on your baby, not the clock.
SenSee is an embodied AI system for visually impaired users that explores how perception can be extended beyond sight. It pairs a LiDAR-equipped wearable vest with AI smart spectacles.
An experience that transports you into the space between dreaming and waking where fear reacts to your presence and awareness becomes the way forward.
Think in 3D: rate ideas in 3 dimensions with your friends and see if you think in the same way!
Mannahatta is an AR portal to New York City in 2100, revealing two futures: one defined by climate collapse, and one built through collective action and sustainability.
Experience a traditional Japanese tea ceremony in XR! Guided by the eccentric yokai, Seto Taisho, guests learn the customs and procedures of temae (点前), a matcha tea serving ceremony.
Our project focuses on creating good habits while learning and collaborating on a community garden of endangered plants with friends!
R-EYE-DER is an hands-free, real-time coaching and safety tool for drivers on the lightweight, everyday-use Raven AR glasses.
ClearCue uses a cloud-based AI model on smart glasses to surface real-time social cues from audio and visual input, helping autistic users reduce ambiguity during live conversations.
AI Photo Assistant for the Snap Specs
RE-MIND is an XR cognitive fitness and life operations companion. Re-MIND offers gentle unintrusive nudges to remind users of prescheduled tasks that promote cognitive well being and quality of life
Walking with BeatMap turns your playlist into a visual experience: watch your environment react to the rhythm in real time.
An AI workflow that turns murals into interactive AR experiences while preserving artist intent
By integrating wearables and AI, XChannels creates a more inclusive and flexible future for immersive interaction where control adapts to people rather than people adapting to the technology.
Combine science with magic. We make the mystical arts easy, personal, and magical.
SnapChem turns chemistry formulas into hands-on learning with physical kits, Snap AR, AI, and Snap Cloud.
Tunisian heritage is often inaccessible or told through outside narratives. We address this with an immersive story of an ancient queen, told with artifacts one of our members had previously scanned.

column1: ABRAZOS - Affective Bodies Reaching Across Zero-space
column2: ABRAZOS is a telehaptic system for embodied affect, remote presence, and somatic communication across networked distances. ABRAZOS lets people feel a hug from someone who isn't physically there.
Play a Steel Drum from Trinidad and Tobago in XR! You can use your controllers to hit the different notes. You can choose different songs and the musical scale will change accordingly.
Tap into a dream world of Indigenous Futurism expressed through a 3D character named Tulip who speaks Diné Bizaad.
An XR experience for people to learn a story in different languages.
AURA is an XR system for emotional co presence, where shared affective states actively shape a collective virtual environment through embodied sensing and social feedback.
Immersive support on the line, from 2D screen to your virtuality
Thoughts Made Visible. AI-Powered Mindmapping in AR.
A VR and physical pet companion for stress and emotional regulation, created using hand tracking on Meta Quest 3, Arduino Uno Q for communication between VR and hardware, and a responsive robotic arm
One ball. One goal. Two players. One tilts a physical board to steer; the other sees the maze and calls the turns. What's more important? Crystal-clear directions? Super steady hands? You need BOFUM!
Real-time safety powered by your community.

column1: Mind Your Bite - Spatial AI for everyday food decisions
column2: Stop wondering 'is this bad?' and start cooking. A hands-free AI assistant that identifies spoiling food and gives you immediate recipes to reduce waste.
ScribbleHero is an AR drawing puzzle game in which you control a magic canvas that can bring whatever you draw to life! Using your object, your task is to figure out a way to put out a burning fire!
Envisioning Better Future
A spatial AR interface for everyday digital tools, powered by AI-driven interaction.

column1: Does the Internet Dream of Itself?
column2: If the internet could dream, we think that it would dream about us. Users swipe through objects while their heartbeat is monitored, and their data shapes the formation of a digital dream world.
Location-specific photo mural where memory persists. No swiping, just discover. No typing, just voice out for remix. Add, react, and remix now in this spatial Snapchat.
It is two-player Mixed Reality experience that explores how individual's inner worlds can transform into a shared connection and explore each other's dream spaces to establish a stronger connection.
We leverage volumetric capture to transform artists into photorealistic 3D presences. Allowing fans to walk around the performance rather than just watching it. Where sound is heard and spatialized.
The only way to truly obtain your dreams, is first to confront your nightmares. A Snap Spectacles immersive installation.
Wearable Geospatial AR Time Radio
Have you ever wondered what the objects around you might say about the world's most famous hacker? This is your chance to WAKE THEM UP and find out!
Wavspace is an immersive, interactive spatial music experience where users explore "music worlds" built around individual songs.
Whoop analytics for cleaning trash! Troop uses AR to quantifies the total environmental impact you personally see over time and encouraging every eco soldier to improve your habits.
A long term PTSD/Anxiety recovery toolkit built on Spectacles
Curated guide to immersive worlds, amazing experiences and AR/VR/XR apps worldwide, searachable with easy-to-discover events, artists and collections
Introducing X Tower. See you in 2036.
ScriptAR helps you write it right like a native speaker. Script AR is for language learners tackling non-Latin alphabets, turning unfamiliar characters into muscle memory.

column1: ARMIE - A Surgical Robot Arm and MR Simulator In Real World
column2: A simulator for surgeons: learn real procedures on a real robotic arm, guided by expert-trained AI in virtual reality.

column1: Chime : Networked Beacons for Meta Wearables Audio UI
column2: A lightweight group-awareness system for shared travel, where one leader stays present while maintaining connection to their group. "Chime in when you need help!"
XR Office is a mixed-reality "ambient desk companion" that turns your schedule, messages, and tasks into physical metaphors you can notice in peripheral vision and interact with intentionally.
A stealth AR toolkit for community resistance.
Hands-On XR STEM Education for Rural Communities
